<thought>From the 13C NMR data, only one signal falls in the typical methyl region (~10‑30 ppm): 26.40 ppm. The other upfield signals (36.40 ppm) are more consistent with methylene or quaternary carbons, not methyls. Therefore the molecule contains a single methyl (CH₃) group.</thought>
<final_answer>1</final_answer>
